normal.text: Playing Pilotwings 64 for the first time, it is a zen game. Love the music, and most of the controls minus rocket belt. Good demo system for first licenses mean you grasp game very quickly. Easy to get into, hard and satisfying to master. Though the levels are tiny by today's standards they are jam packed with little details, seem to be full of life. Am not someone who sings praises of retro games usually, so this is a welcome surprise. #gaming #retrogaming #Nintendo64 #Pilotwings
